_about: Device labels and how every app shows them (ov-560 R1). Read by the relay (notices.ts shownLabel and common.ts nameOf), the web (runners.ts shownLabel), AgentKit and Android (DeviceKeyRow.shownLabel). Each case: what a registering session sent, and what a screen or notice shows; `refused` when the relay's nameOf refuses it outright.
